QUOTE: `ssl_pthread_server.c` builds to a stub `main` that prints "MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD not defined" and exits when threading is off (lines 24–29).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that with the default config no thread is spawned from `library/` and that the pthread example compiles to a stub `main` when threading is off.
